note: The side-picker. Six questions, each answer gives points to styles. Nothing is stored anywhere but the reader's own browser, and only if they ask. The result links to the style's page; it is a game, not a verdict.
title: Which side are you on?
lede: Six questions. At the end, a style claims you. Every Carolinian already knows the answer; this is for the rest of you.

questions.q: The sauce on the table should be…

a.t: clear, sharp, mostly vinegar — you can see the pepper flakes
reddish and thin, a little sweet, poured not spread
yellow. Mustard. Obviously.
thick, red, sticky, sweet — it should cling
white, creamy, on the sandwich
red, because it is dressed with the dip
fine, whatever, pass the hash
a side dish, not a topping

questions.q: The pig arrives at the pit as…

a.t: the whole hog, split down the back, skin up
shoulders, and only shoulders
hams and shoulders, whatever the pit runs
shoulders, butts, ribs and a chicken or two
a square of dense cornbread, or corn sticks
hushpuppies, a basket of them
white bread, the soft kind, for the hash
a bun, and the sandwich is the point

questions.q: Rice on a barbecue plate is…

a.t: correct, under the hash
a South Carolina thing; we have boiled potatoes
unheard of; where is the red slaw?
fine if there is chicken bog too
"A tray, and some skins."
"Coarse chopped, outside brown, extra dip."
"The buffet, and is the hash out yet?"
"A pound, and a quart of the sweet sauce."

eastern-nc.title: Eastern North Carolina
eastern-nc.say: Whole hog, vinegar and pepper, white slaw, cornbread. You believe tomatoes are for salad. Ayden is your capital and you will fight about it.

lexington.title: Lexington
lexington.say: Shoulders over hickory, red dip, red slaw, hushpuppies. You know what outside brown is and you order it by name.

sc-mustard.title: The South Carolina Midlands
sc-mustard.say: Mustard. Yellow, tangy, with hash over rice beside it. The Dutch Fork settled this question two hundred years ago.

sc-pee-dee.title: The Pee Dee
sc-pee-dee.say: Whole hog over hardwood coals, vinegar and pepper, a country store with a pit out back. Hemingway is closer than you think.

sc-light-tomato.title: Light tomato South Carolina
sc-light-tomato.say: Vinegar and pepper with a little ketchup stirred in — enough to blush, not enough to stick. You are a diplomat.

sc-heavy-tomato.title: The Upstate
sc-heavy-tomato.say: Thick, sweet, red. Ribs and chicken are welcome at your table. The rest of the Carolinas will get over it.
